extName.message: QuizPilot – AI Quiz Helper & Study Helper

extDescription.message: AI quiz solver & homework helper: reads practice questions on web pages, suggests answers with confidence, and fills or marks them.

tier_fast_hint.message: Jev and a light LLM answer in seconds; each question counts as 1.

tier_accurate_hint.message: An advanced AI model thinks through each question: more accurate, but slower. Each question counts as {n}; unanswered ones are free.

mode_byok_hint.message: Use your own model API key, stored only on this device

mode_paid_hint.message: No setup: pay per question answered

regionHint.message: Reading screenshots needs an image-capable model

solveAutoHint.message: Answers a question, moves to the next one, and repeats at a human pace. Stop any time from the answer panel. Never submits.

relearnHint.message: Use when questions are missed or wrong: relearns this site's question layout from a screenshot

solveAssistHint.message: Outlines the suggested answer for you to pick; marks the next question when the page moves on. The extension never clicks or types on the page.

err_noQuestions.message: No questions found on this page

err_noQuestionsNoVision.message: No questions found on this page. Add an image-capable model to read it from a screenshot.

note_unreadableOptions.message: Couldn't read the options, so it wasn't answered. Try "Solve a selected area" on this question.

st_waitFront.message: Screenshots need this tab in front: switch back here and it carries on

err_pageChanged.message: The page reloaded, navigated away or closed while answering, so the answers were not all filled in. Go back to the questions and solve again.

err_tabClosed.message: The tab was closed; continuous mode ended

auto_captcha.message: Verification required: please complete it yourself. Answering resumes afterwards.

auto_captchaTimeout.message: Timed out waiting for verification; continuous mode ended

auto_noMore.message: No more questions; continuous mode ended

auto_notFillable.message: This page's questions can't be filled in automatically; continuous mode ended

auto_noNext.message: No "next question" button found; continuous mode ended

auto_lastQuestion.message: Last question reached. Check your answers, then click "{label}" yourself.

auto_nextNoChange.message: Clicked "next" but the question didn't change; continuous mode ended

assist_marked.message: Suggested answers are outlined (green; orange means unsure). Pick them yourself; new questions are marked as they appear.

assist_shown.message: Answers are listed below; answer yourself. New questions are marked as they appear.

assist_idle.message: The page hasn't changed for a long time; assist mode ended

err_learnNeedsVision.message: Learning a page's layout needs an image-capable model

st_shotWholePage.message: No readable question text; reading a screenshot…

err_regionNeedsVision.message: Solving a selected area needs an image-capable model

err_cantRun.message: Can't run on this page (browser pages and the Web Store don't allow extensions)

tag_noImage.message: Image not seen; for reference only

err_googleNoToken.message: Didn't get a Google sign-in token

err_paidNeedsLogin.message: Paid mode needs you to sign in: click the QuizPilot icon in the toolbar

err_byokNoKey.message: Free mode needs a model API key: add one in Settings

err_sessionExpired.message: Your session expired; please sign in again

err_insufficient.message: Not enough left for {tier} mode ({required} needed, {balance} left). Top up in the extension popup.

err_loginExpired.message: Your session expired; click the QuizPilot icon to sign in again

err_frozen.message: Account frozen (refund or dispute). Please contact support.

err_rateLimited.message: Too many requests; please try again shortly

err_tooManyAttempts.message: Too many attempts; request a new code

err_otpCooldown.message: Please wait {s} seconds before requesting another code

err_serverVision.message: Image reading isn't available right now; please try again later

err_needsVision.message: This question needs an image-capable model

err_unsupported.message: No model is set up for this kind of question

err_auth.message: Invalid API key or no access

err_busy.message: The model service is busy; please try again

ui_regionTip.message: Drag to select the question area, Esc to cancel

opt_byokHint.message: Use your own model API key. The key stays on this device and requests go straight to the model provider.

opt_paidHint.message: No setup: sign in and pay per question (sign in and top up from the popup).

opt_humanizeHint.message: Answers at a human pace in both "Solve this page" and Continuous mode: reading pauses, gaps between questions, typed text. Off answers faster.

opt_reviewHint.message: When a multiple-choice or true/false answer is uncertain, the review model answers it again (one more model call; pick the review model under Routing in Free mode models).

opt_needPermission.message: Grant access to the model provider's domain so the extension can call its API

opt_modelsTip.message: Tip: an advanced model (a stronger reasoning model) answers more accurately, but more slowly.

opt_modelsIntro.message: Jev is recommended for multiple-choice and true/false. Fill-in and short answers need a text model; screenshots and picture questions need an image-capable model. API keys are stored only in this browser.

opt_reviewIntro.message: With "Review low-confidence answers" on, uncertain multiple-choice and true/false answers go to the review model. You can add a stronger model (such as a large model on OpenRouter) just for reviewing.

opt_thresholdHint.message: Review when confidence is below this (needs "Review low-confidence answers")

opt_debugHint.message: Records each step of reading, learning page layouts, answering and filling in, to help track down problems. Kept on this device and cleared when the browser closes; it includes question text but never API keys.

opt_historyLogin.message: Sign in (from the popup) to see your history

preset_jevOpenRouterHint.message: Calls Jev with an OpenRouter key. Great at multiple-choice and true/false, fast and cheap; cannot write text or read images.

preset_jevTypeSafeHint.message: Calls Jev with a TypeSafe console key. Great at multiple-choice and true/false; cannot write text or read images.

grant_ok.message: Your new account got {n} free questions ({m} in Accurate mode)

grant_disposable.message: Temporary email addresses don't get the free questions; top up to start

grant_email_used.message: This mailbox already got the free questions before; top up to start

grant_device_used.message: The free questions were already claimed on this computer; top up to start

grant_ip_limit.message: Today's free questions for this network are used up; top up to start

grant_daily_cap.message: Today's free questions for new accounts have run out; top up to start

preset_doubaoHint.message: For the model, use a model ID from the Ark console (e.g. doubao-seed-…) or an inference endpoint ID

opt_modelsFound.message: Found {n} models; pick one in the Model field

opt_listFailed.message: Couldn't list models: {msg}. You can type the model name

opt_modelPlaceholder.message: Enter the key, then click "List models"

popup_keyLocal.message: Your key stays on this computer. Questions go straight to the provider you chose, never through our servers.

popup_tryPaid.message: Rather not set up a key? Paid mode works out of the box, with free questions for new accounts.

act_assistDesc.message: Marks the answer; you pick it yourself

act_autoDesc.message: Moves on by itself; stop any time

act_regionDesc.message: Drag around a question to read it

act_learnDesc.message: When questions are missed or wrong

sc_intro.message: Press a shortcut on any page to start. Pressing the Assist or Continuous shortcut again stops it.

rep_intro.message: If a site reads questions wrong, gets stuck or picks wrong answers, send us the log so we can fix support for that site.

rep_notePh.message: e.g. question 7 was wrong, the answer is B

rep_privacy.message: The log includes page addresses, questions and answers. It is emailed to QuizPilot support and used only to investigate the problem and improve site support. It never includes API keys.

rep_sent.message: Sent, thank you! We will look into it soon.

rep_enableFirst.message: Turn on "Record a debug log", reproduce the problem, then send.

err_billingUnavailable.message: Top-ups are unavailable right now; please try again later
